shr_curator.text: Five miles from here is Wroxeter, the Roman city of Viroconium. In its day it was one of the biggest towns in Roman Britain, with baths and a forum. Some of what they dug up is in these cases.

Upstairs is a gallery about Darwin, and a stretch of the town's story from the Saxons to the shopping centre. The silver Wroxeter mirror is the best thing in the building. Don't tell the other exhibits.
